post.description: An active member with its own Plivo endpoint, Offline, with the routing row every strategy joins.

patch.description: A new role ends the agent's sessions: its tokens carry the old one.

post.description:
Agent and stream tokens plus a Plivo SDK token for the agent's endpoint, which cannot outlive them. Plivo mints
the SDK token: it refuses one signed anywhere else.
A new endpoint password, set at Plivo and shown once: HS keeps no SIP password.

Hangs up the requester's own leg (a key's: the call's agent's), as when they hang up their phone. The leave
that follows hands the caller to a transfer target who answered, or ends the call.
A third party joins the conference (two at most): another agent's endpoint, or a number.

A warm transfer hands over: everyone is taken off hold, the target becomes primary and the first agent's
leg is hung up.
A note on the conversation, while an agent is on the call; a tenant key writes as that agent.

One agent's disposition: an agent token's own, or the named agent's for a tenant key. The conversation
closes after its last wrap-up.

Push the agent's own auto wrap-up deadline back, up to max_extend_sec in all; the stream carries the new
deadline.
`system: true` makes a locked row that the status map can point at.
The listed dispositions take the places they already hold, in the order given; the rest stay put.

get.description: Live events; resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after= (the header wins).

post.description: Presence: the second ping of a session applies the sign-in status; 40 s without one sets Offline.

put.description: Checks at Plivo that the number is the sub-account's, points it at the tenant's application, stores it.

post.description:
Hand a live call to the queue. A Plivo form request (the queue's enqueue_url, query `agents`, `context`,
`consent_played=1`) gets XML; a tenant key's JSON gets the queue entry.

200.description: Plivo XML for a form request

delete.description: Deletes the recording at Plivo too, and with the call's last recording its per-participant tracks.

get.description: The audio, for whoever holds a signed URL that has not expired (an `<audio src>` sends no header).

patch.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) over the settings body; the whole result is validated before anything is saved.

delete.description: Refuse every credential of the tenant, then remove its endpoints and application at Plivo.

patch.description: Rename, replace the Plivo token (checked with Plivo first) and re-apply the app URLs from PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

get.description: Available agents with a free call slot, and the teams they are in.

post.description: The old secret stays valid for 24 h; meanwhile deliveries carry both signatures.
A menu's entry (its menu_url, no attempt) or one attempt's input (Digits, or none: no input).

Plivo transferred the caller here: into the room an API enqueue admitted it to, or out of a room to run the
queue or voicemail action an agent chose.

The caller left a queue: (a) wait timeout, (b) an exit key, (c) no agent took it -> overflow; (d) otherwise
(the room ended after an agent call) hang up.
A voicemail's Record finished: keep the message and hang up.
A call HS answered ended. One a queue or an agent took is the MPC callbacks'; any other closes 10 s later.
